item.title: FREE LRT/MRT and PITX Rides for Women
item.description: This International Women’s Day, commuting gets a little brighter for women across Metro Manila. Women enjoy #LibrengSakay at LRT & MRT on March 8 and March 9, 2026, as a heartfelt gesture of gratitude for the invaluable contributions of women to society. And that’s not all—free rides are also available at PITX for female commuters every Tuesday and Thursday until March 26, 2026.

item.title: Timeless Charm: Discovering Stoneware Pottery in Cagayan de Oro Philippines
item.description: Collecting has always been part of who I am, and teapots are one of my quirks. Over time, being surrounded by them encouraged me to embrace the ritual of tea drinking, and today, matcha green tea has become my favorite. During a visit to Cagayan de Oro, my “shopping research” led me to a hidden treasure—a small stoneware pottery shop nestled in Bulua. It’s the kind of place that feels one-of-a-kind, and naturally, I couldn’t leave without adding another piece to my collection.
